actionable_steps.citation: When women are honoured — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 28 (1995), 1995-11-19
actionable_steps.step: Honour and respect women in daily life — where women are honoured and esteemed, there divinity is present with all its potency.

actionable_steps.citation: God Protects Those Who Protect Sathya and Dharma — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 37 (2004), 2004-09-06
actionable_steps.step: Never let your women shed tears — never cause them distress, for homes where women shed tears are ruined in no time.

actionable_steps.citation: Women Are The Embodiments Of Nobility And Virtue — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 33 (2000), 2000-08-11
actionable_steps.step: Treat women with respect, so that you will be respected in turn — and the world will attain prosperity when they are respected.

actionable_steps.citation: God Protects Those Who Protect Sathya and Dharma — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 37 (2004), 2004-09-06
actionable_steps.step: When you visit a temple, make a vow that you will respect and protect the women.

actionable_steps.citation: The Mother Divine — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 21 (1988), 1988-10-14
actionable_steps.step: Revere your own mother as God — she is greater than heaven itself, and reverence to her is your paramount duty.

definition.citation: Women Are The Embodiments Of Nobility And Virtue — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 33 (2000), 2000-08-11
definition.quote: Women are the embodiment of virtue and nobility.

discourses.citation: When women are honoured — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 28 (1995), 1995-11-19
discourses.quote: The Veda declares that where women are honoured and esteemed, there divinity is present with all its potency. … Sthree (Woman) is Grihalakshmi (the Goddess of Prosperity for the home). She is hailed as Dharmapathni (the virtuous spouse).

discourses.citation: God Protects Those Who Protect Sathya and Dharma — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 37 (2004), 2004-09-06
discourses.quote: Those who ill-treat their wives can never be happy and prosperous. … Women are really the presiding deities of their homes. … It is only when the women are safe, the whole world will be happy.

discourses.citation: Glory of womanhood — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 31 (1998), 1998-04-19
discourses.quote: The scriptures have ascribed seven virtues to women as a class: sathya (truth), prema (love), dharma (righteousness), santhi (peace), sahana (tolerance), ananda (bliss), svanubhuti (spirituality). … The woman is the embodiment of sacrifice.

discourses.citation: Good Mothers Are Nation's Pride — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 34 (2001), 2001-11-19
discourses.quote: Only if the women come up in society, the whole world will turn sacred. … Women are capable of ruling the nations and even the whole world if they make up their minds.

make_it_real: Divinity walks the earth with a woman's face — honour her today, and watch your home turn sacred.
title: Women & Mothers
